_comment: All tunable game numbers. A plain number is a confirmed rule from CLAUDE.md. An object with "placeholder": true is a temporary value that is not decided yet; read it through Config.get_value(), which returns its "value".

first_day_start_hour.comment: Clock time (24 h) when the first day starts.

max_sleep_hours.comment: Maximum hours on the sleep slider.

health_weights._comment: Placeholder health formula: weighted average of the three measures (0 to 1), mapped to health_min..health_max. Sleep has the largest weight because it affects the other measures the most.

per_level.comment: XP needed to fill the bar once (one level).

gain_per_avatar_hour.comment: XP gained per avatar hour while health is at or above high_health_min.

loss_per_avatar_hour.comment: XP lost per avatar hour while health is at or below low_health_max.

tired_fatigue.comment: Fatigue at or above this shows the tired state.

hungry_hunger.comment: Hunger at or above this shows the hungry state.

sad_mental.comment: Mental at or below this shows the sad state.

ill_health.comment: Health at or below this shows the ill state.

language.comment: Starting language until settings exist. pt or en.

avatar_name.comment: Set on the avatar creation screen.
